steps.label: su -
steps.sub: full root shell; needs root's own password

steps.label: sudo cmd
steps.sub: one command as root; needs YOUR password

steps.label: sudo wins
steps.sub: scoped, logged, and tied to explicit permission

code:
$ sudo visudo
mchen    ALL=(ALL) ALL
%ops     ALL=(ALL) ALL
jramirez ALL=(root) /usr/bin/systemctl restart nginx
caption: user/group  host = (run-as user)  commands. % marks a group rule.
NOPASSWD skips the prompt — keep it scoped to one command, never ALL.

code:
$ sudo -l
User jramirez may run on web01:
    (root) /usr/bin/systemctl restart nginx
caption: sudo -l lists exactly what the current user is permitted to run.

subtitle: setuid, setgid, the sticky bit, and fine-grained access with ACLs.
